SPECIFICATION & FORMULA

Calculation Methodology

Monthly Tokens = Daily Requests × 30 × Tokens/Request. Monthly Cost = (Monthly Tokens / 1,000,000) × Price per 1M × (1 - Caching Discount %).

Reference Notes & FAQ

Does this fetch live model pricing or apply provider-specific cache rules?

No. Enter a weighted input/output price and an effective discount across your modeled workload. Provider-specific pricing tiers, cache eligibility, retries and tool fees are excluded.
